## 2. Copy framing

You know the feeling. You finish a meal and reach for the waistband. You choose what to wear based on how your stomach will look by evening. You turn down plans because you cannot predict how your gut will behave. You have built your whole day around managing it.

Bloating is not about what you eat. It is about what your body cannot break down. Undigested food ferments. That is the gas. That is the pressure. That is the puffiness in your face by noon. And a single probiotic or enzyme cannot fix all of it because the problem is not one layer deep.

IM8 Daily Ultimate Essentials addresses all four. Digestive enzymes to break down the backlog. Spore-forming probiotics that survive stomach acid to crowd out the gas-producing bacteria. Prebiotics to feed the right environment. Postbiotics to support gut lining integrity. All four phases working together. 90 clinically dosed ingredients. One scoop every morning.
